precepts.text: Meditation is like a portrait in an art gallery: the one who loves it stands and examines a thousand details the surface look never sees; be settled on the scripture, the counsel, and the class the same way.
precepts.point: Thou shalt meditate therein day and night: to meditate is to think deeply and carefully, to contemplate, consider, ponder, and muse. Many read their four chapters a day, listen to videos, and quote their precept lists, but never meditate on what they read. You cannot just slap the butter on the biscuit; you have to let it sink into every layer.

note.label: Joshua 1: The Charge to Joshua and the Formula for Success

precepts.why:
“thou shalt meditate therein day and night”. To meditate is to think deeply and carefully, to contemplate, consider, ponder, and muse. “A heart settled upon a thought of understanding is as a fair plaistering on the wall of a gallery.”

Meditation is like a portrait in an art gallery: the one who loves it stands and examines a thousand details the surface look never sees. Be settled on the scripture, the counsel, and the class the same way. Many read their four chapters a day, listen to videos, and quote their precept lists, but never meditate on what they read. You cannot just slap the butter on the biscuit; you have to let it sink into every layer.

precepts.text: I will not be ashamed to defend a friend, neither will I hide myself from him; even with his father the king gone crazy, Jonathan would not abandon David.
precepts.point: Jonathan would have been next in line for the throne; you would think his loyalty lay with his daddy, but he saw the spirit was not on his father, it was on his brother David. His loyalty exceeded his own desires. That is the kind of friend to look for, and the lesson to learn from Jonathan.

note.label: 1 Samuel 19: A Faithful Friend Is a Strong Defence

precepts.why:
“I will not be ashamed to defend a friend; neither will I hide myself from him.” Even with his father the king gone crazy, Jonathan would not abandon David.

He stood in the gap for him: “I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.”

points: Now remember, counsel is when a man weighs options, determines what should be done. Yeah. Read it. I'm in the wrong place. I'm sorry. Go ahead, read again.

Right? A heart that is established by advised counsel shall fear at no time. Always bounce off of understanding ideas, what you think. We're men of understanding. Ask questions. What do you think? 99.9% of the time, when a person does not ask for counsel, is because they don't want to be told what they're doing is wrong. And guess what? 99.9% of the time, they already know it's wrong. That's why they don't ask. They don't want to be told what to do.

I'm going to give you part of my history. I said this a thousand times in class. In my early years of the truth, I went to Bishop and I told him I wanted to move to Florida, just before I moved. And he told me, man, sit down. You don't know nothing. Keep quiet. Looked at him. I'm like, who he think you talking to? What? He just blew me up, like, you don't know nothing. You don't know them scriptures. And so I sat down, and I was thinking to myself, what do you mean? And I said, is he trying to teach me to sin? This is the conversation I had with myself. I said, is he trying to teach me to sin against God? No. I said, so why are you going to Florida? Oh, my mama's going to put down some money in the house. I said, is your mother the devil? I said, yeah. I said, I better shut up. So I didn't go. It could have been maybe ten-something years later, I asked, I said to him again, and he didn't remember the conversation. I said, I've been about to move to Florida. He said, all right, just go down there and build. I know, had I not listened the first time, I wouldn't be in the truth today. I know me. I wouldn't. And when I told Bishop that years later, he didn't remember. He said he don't remember me saying, he told me, I just keep crying.

And guess what? I really didn't know nothing, because after that I came to him. I said, yo, I got some scriptures I want to show leadership. I said, I found a precept so we could smoke weed. And he start laughing, kicked me out the office. And the precept was on mandrakes. He's like, shut up. Get out the office. He kicked me out. But I would have left with that understanding. Whatever I thought understanding was, I'd have been a weed head right now. Thank the Lord. My dumb behind. Clap for the Lord. Thank you, Lord. Thank you, Lord. That would have been a major fumble. Overweight and a drug addict. Thank you, God.

Proverbs 19 and 20. Sometimes, I'm telling you, brothers, the greatest gift you young men could have is the art of listening. If you listen, you will save yourself so much headache. Just listen. We don't have no skin in the game to lead you in the wrong direction. We trying to help you all. We could save you all from making major mistakes, because either we experienced it or we seen it happen. Y'all can cut the curve and save yourself headaches. But if you don't want to, you could do it your way and see how it works out for you. Proverbs chapter 19 and verse 20.

points: An evil nurtured son is the dishonour of his father that begat him. Now let me tell you something about the evil nurtured child. Like the videos we just looked at with all those kids fighting — we might think that is the only evil nurtured child. No. Raising them up as a Christian is an equally evil nurtured child, and may even be worse, because you are not teaching them the fundamentals of the Bible, what to beware of, what to look out for. You are misguiding them. Everybody is the same in Jesus, Jesus loves everybody. Now your child is dead because you as a Christian parent misguided them.

points: She that is bold dishonoureth both her father and her husband, but they both shall despise her. That bold woman — she says what she wants to say, goes where she wants to go, does what she wants to do.

note.label: When Children Walk in a Land of Shadows (Part 2)

points: Sand, and salt, and a mass of iron, is easier to bear, than a man without understanding. The sand and the salt goes into back in the day — they would carry sand and salt, put it in bags, and it is very heavy. The same thing with iron; when you are carrying a mass of iron, iron is heavy.

So it is easier to bear these heavy things than to be around somebody that is just stupid. Why? Because they will argue with you all the time. They will never want to take the blame for what they did, and they will always cause confusion. It is easier to carry those heavy burdens than to deal with somebody that is a fool.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: What is heavier than lead but a fool: a man without understanding is harder to bear than sand, salt and a mass of iron, because he always has to bump his head instead of taking counsel.
